name: Class I charger - dielectric withstand (CONFIRM VALUES vs product standard)

steps.title: Input (L+N shorted) to earth / metal case
steps.instruction: Plug the charger into the fixture socket (L and N are shorted inside it). Connect the HV probe to the L+N post and the return clip to the earth/case post.

steps.title: Input (L+N shorted) to DC output
steps.instruction: Keep the plug in the socket. Connect the HV probe to the L+N post and the return clip to BOTH output leads clipped together (blue + black).
